'operationalising models' is mapped to mlops (it means putting models into production). That mapping is an interpretation, so it is flagged uncertain.
'full ML lifecycle' has no clear taxonomy entry, so it goes to unmapped.
machine-learning is not labeled: the qualification names 'ML lifecycle', not ML itself.
'frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch' gives examples for one ask, so tensorflow and pytorch form alternative group 1.
'cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)' groups aws, azure and gcp as group 2. cloud is labeled separately because the text names it, and it stays out of the group.
'container and orchestration tools' names containerization literally, so it is labeled. 'orchestration' here means container orchestration, not llm-orchestration.
'Docker & Kubernetes' are asked for together, so they are not alternatives.
System design and pair programming appear only in the interview process, so they are not labeled.
Security clearance, communication skills and the client-facing ask are not skills.
No German or degree is mentioned anywhere in the posting.
